Based on the methodology and figure caption provided, here is a detailed description of the illustrative diagram.

### Overall Layout and Style
The figure is a high-resolution (300 DPI), publication-quality diagram designed for a single-column width in an academic paper. It has a wide and short aspect ratio (approximately 3.35:1.5). The overall aesthetic is clean, minimalist, and sophisticated, utilizing a sans-serif font like Helvetica or Arial.

**Crucially, the entire canvas background is PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF).**

The diagram is organized into three distinct panels arranged horizontally from left to right. Each panel is presented as a card with rounded corners (6-8px radius), a very light gray fill (#F5F6F8), a thin, light gray border (#E0E3E8), and a subtle drop shadow to give it a slight lift from the background. The color palette is muted and harmonious, consisting of a primary blue (#4878CF), coral (#D65F5F), teal (#2D9B8F), and amber (#E8A838).

### Panel 1: ① Model Zoo
*   **Layout:** This is the leftmost panel, occupying approximately 28% of the total width.
*   **Title:** At the top, centered, is the title "① Model Zoo" in 12pt bold, dark gray text (#2D2D2D).
*   **Content:** The panel contains three vertically stacked rows, each representing a different model architecture.
    *   **Row 1 (GDN):** Labeled "GDN" in bold blue (#4878CF) text at the bottom of the row. Above the label are two small, side-by-side rounded rectangles. The left rectangle has a very light blue fill with the text "Pure" in blue. The right rectangle has a solid blue fill with the text "+Attn" in bold white.
    *   **Row 2 (RetNet):** Follows the same layout as the first row. It is labeled "RetNet" in bold coral (#D65F5F). The left box has a very light coral fill with "Pure" in coral, and the right box has a solid coral fill with "+Attn" in bold white.
    *   **Row 3 (HGRN2):** Follows the same layout. It is labeled "HGRN2" in bold teal (#2D9B8F). The left box has a very light teal fill with "Pure" in teal, and the right box has a solid teal fill with "+Attn" in bold white.

### Panel 2: ② Per-Example Decomposition
*   **Layout:** This is the central panel, occupying approximately 36% of the total width.
*   **Title:** At the top, centered, is the title "② Per-Example Decomposition" in 12pt bold text.
*   **Subtitle:** Directly below the title is an italicized, 9pt gray subtitle: "pure(xᵢ) vs hybrid(xᵢ)".
*   **Content:** The main content is a single vertical column of small, colored dots, visually separated into three groups by thin, light gray horizontal lines.
    *   **Top Group:** A cluster of 3 amber (#E8A838) dots. To the right, it is labeled "helped" in bold, dark gold text.
    *   **Middle Group:** A cluster of 2 rose-colored (#996B6B) dots. To the right, it is labeled "hurt" in bold, dark red text.
    *   **Bottom Group:** A cluster of 5 light gray (#D5D5D5) dots. To the right, it is labeled "unchanged" in gray text.
*   **Footer:** At the bottom of the panel, there is a small, italicized gray text annotation: "× 3 architecture pairs".

### Panel 3: ③ Cross-Architecture Overlap
*   **Layout:** This is the rightmost panel, occupying the remaining 36% of the width.
*   **Title:** At the top, centered, is the title "③ Cross-Architecture Overlap" in 12pt bold text.
*   **Content:** The central element is a Venn diagram composed of three large circles. A key feature is that the circles are **almost completely separate**, with only a minuscule, sliver-like overlap where their edges barely touch (the intersection area should be less than 3% of any single circle's area).
    *   **Blue Circle:** Has a semi-transparent blue fill (#4878CF at 15% opacity) and is labeled "GDN" with text placed outside the circle.
    *   **Coral Circle:** Has a semi-transparent coral fill (#D65F5F at 15% opacity) and is labeled "RetNet" outside the circle.
    *   **Teal Circle:** Has a semi-transparent teal fill (#2D9B8F at 15% opacity) and is labeled "HGRN2" outside the circle.
*   **Annotations:**
    *   In the geometric center of the three circles, the text "J ≈ 0.10" is displayed in bold. It has a subtle white text shadow or halo to ensure it stands out against the faint colors of the circles.
    *   Below the Venn diagram, a concluding statement in small, italic gray text reads: "low overlap → architecture-specific sensitivity".

### Connections and Flow
*   **Panel 1 to Panel 2:** Three thin (0.6pt), light gray (#8C8C8C) arrows originate from the three model rows in Panel 1 (one arrow per row) and point towards the central column of dots in Panel 2, indicating that the decomposition is performed for each architecture pair.
*   **Panel 2 to Panel 3:** Three curved, light gray arrows originate from the general area of the dot column in Panel 2 and converge on the center of the Venn diagram in Panel 3. This signifies that the results of the per-example decomposition are used to calculate the cross-architecture overlap.
*   **Arrow Style:** All arrowheads are small, sharp, and elegant, avoiding a bulky appearance.
